corroborating_evidence_only.why_this_does_not_pass_the_gate: the owner directive is explicit: 'Do NOT infer data rights from a GitHub code licence. The 100STYLE source itself must establish the data licence.' A redistributor restating an upstream licence is a stronger signal than a search snippet, but it is still not the upstream author's own statement. It is recorded as corroboration and nothing more.

reasons: it is RETARGETED onto a different common skeleton — it is not the unedited 28-bone 100STYLE source the experiment specifies
an upstream motion-editing step by a third party breaks the 'representation change, not motion editing' guarantee before ONIQ's own adapter even starts
its SHA-256 could not be checked against any official file, so provenance would be unverifiable
it ships the Geno character, which the owner directive explicitly excludes
its download host theorangeduck.com is blocked anyway (connect_rejected 403)
